identification: Pine shipping crate holding roughly 20-25 steel-jaw (gin) rabbit traps plus 3 hung on the crate sides, so about 23-28 traps. Standard Australian single long-spring rabbit trap pattern (Lane's / Ace / Cyclone type), mixed, some with chains and pegs, a few with red paint traces. Heavy surface rust throughout; tangled so springs and pans can't be judged. No unusual large or double-spring patterns visible.

viewing_check: Tip the box out and count; look on the spring and pan for stamps (Lane, Ace, Bunyip, Platypus, Sidebotham, Cyclone): branded traps are worth A$30-45 each, unbranded A$8-15. Check for any unusual large fox/dingo traps.
